changes.title: Party spell
items: The game starts with the party spell: she stands at her decks until you press CAST THE PARTY SPELL (or Enter, or R), casts it in a burst of sparkles, and off you go

changes.title: Legend groves
items: The forest swells round each sleeping legend's circle: thicker and taller trees close by, easing back into the ordinary woods, open on the near side as the way in

changes.title: Stone crackle
items: Each runestone crackles into life as it becomes a speaker or a soundsystem: static, a rising hum, then a clean note, the home ring's twelve climbing a scale and the last ringing out a chord
